messages.content: 想像一下你是一位房地產投資者。你5年前以50萬美元買下了一個物業。該物業的年折舊率為2%。你能計算出該物業目前的折舊值嗎？現在，假設你在同一時間有20萬美元的資金。如果過去5年的年通貨膨脹率為3%，那麼這筆資金今天的價值是多少？另外，假設你借了30萬美元，年利率為4%，用於購買該物業。如果貸款期限為10年，你每月的還款金額是多少？最後，如果你每月計算物業的折舊，而不是每年，那麼該物業的折舊值是多少？

function.name: finance_loan_repayment
function.description: Calculates the monthly repayment for a loan. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

loan_amount.description: The amount borrowed or loaned. This is a float type value.

interest_rate.description: The annual interest rate. This is a float type value.

loan_term.description: The term of the loan in years.

function.name: finance_inflation_adjustment
function.description: Adjusts a sum of money for inflation based on the consumer price index (CPI). Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

initial_sum.description: The initial sum of money. This is a float type value.

years.description: The number of years over which inflation is calculated.

inflation_rate.description: The annual rate of inflation. This is a float type value.

function.name: finance_property_depreciation
function.description: Calculates the depreciated value of a property given its initial cost, depreciation rate, and the number of years. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

initial_cost.description: The initial cost of the property. This is a float type value.

depreciation_rate.description: The annual depreciation rate in percentage. This is a float type value.

years.description: The number of years for which to calculate the depreciation.

monthly.description: If set to true, it will calculate monthly depreciation instead of annually. (optional)

We need to call functions. Three calculations: property depreciation over 5 years, inflation adjustment for $200k over 5 years at 3% annual, loan repayment monthly for loan 300k, 4% annual, 10-year term. Also monthly depreciation for property: 5 years monthly depreciation? Actually monthly depreciation value after 5 years? They ask "如果你每月計算物業的折舊，而不是每年，那麼該物業的折舊值是多少？" Means compute depreciation per month over 5 years? Probably compute monthly depreciation amount: initial cost 500k, depreciation rate 2% per year, monthly depreciation = (500k * 0.02)/12 = 833.33 per month. Over 5 years, total depreciation = 833.33*60 = 50,000. So same as annual depreciation. But they might want monthly depreciation value after 5 years? Actually "該物業的折舊值" maybe the accumulated depreciation after 5 years if calculated monthly. That would be same as annual: 50k. But maybe they want monthly depreciation amount: 833.33. We'll provide both.

Let's compute using functions.

First: finance_property_depreciation with initial_cost=500000, depreciation_rate=2, years=5, monthly=false. That returns depreciated value? The function likely returns depreciated value after years. We'll call.

Second: finance_inflation_adjustment with initial_sum=200000, years=5, inflation_rate=3.

Third: finance_loan_repayment with loan_amount=300000, interest_rate=4, loan_term=10.

Fourth: finance_property_depreciation with monthly=true to get monthly depreciation? The function may return monthly depreciation value? It says "If set to true, it will calculate monthly depreciation instead of annually." So we call with monthly=true. That will return monthly depreciation amount? Probably returns depreciation per month. We'll call.
